description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

TikTok USDS Joint Venture is hiring a graduate software engineer for its e-commerce platform. The role focuses on building and operating big-data computing and storage systems, optimizing distributed systems, and improving the efficiency and scalability of large-scale e-commerce services.
Graduate Software Engineer building big-data frameworks and storage systems, designing high-concurrency distributed systems for e-commerce platforms

Responsibilities:
• Build and operate innovative big data computing frameworks and storage systems to empower large-scale platform services
• Design and optimize high-concurrency distributed systems to ensure stability during peak global traffic
• Collaborate cross-functionally with internal and external stakeholders to drive large-scale engineering initiatives
• Drive technical innovation by integrating new ideas and emerging technologies into the core platform
• Enhance system efficiency and scalability to support the rapid growth of the global e-commerce ecosystem

Requirements:
• Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor's/ Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, Statistics, or a related discipline
• Experience in big data processing and storage frameworks, e.g. Hadoop, Flink, Spark, Kafka, Hive, HBase, Redis, RocksDB, etc
• Strong Computer Science fundamentals (coding, algorithms, data structures, software design) and problem-solving skills
• Ability to think critically and to formulate solutions to problems in a clear and concise way
• Effective communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive

Preferred:
• Experience in risk control or governance domain
• Experience with building large-scale machine learning infrastructure
• Experience of Peta Byte level data processing
